key.name: node-position-x
key.description: Node's x position, normalized as a 0..1 fraction of its monitor's work-area width.

key.name: node-position-y
key.description: Node's y position, normalized as a 0..1 fraction of its monitor's work-area height.

key.name: node-monitor-connector
key.summary: Monitor connector the Node last lived on
key.description: Stable monitor connector name (e.g. eDP-1, DP-2), not a numeric monitor index, since indices are not stable across reconnects.

key.name: disabled-ubuntu-dock
key.summary: Whether this extension disabled Ubuntu Dock
key.description: True iff this extension is the one that turned ubuntu-dock@ubuntu.com off, and is therefore responsible for turning it back on when this extension is disabled.

key.name: putty-palette
key.description: The curated color palette used by the Node, bridge, and application panel.

key.name: node-scale
key.description: Compositor scale applied to the native 64 by 60 pixel Node texture.

key.name: motion-style
key.description: Whether Putty follows GNOME animations, uses reduced motion, or disables transitions.
